title: Clique decompositions and covers for large graphs
summary: In 1966, Erdős, Goodman, and Pósa showed that every $n$-vertex graph $G$ admits a cover of its edges using at most $\lfloor \frac{n^2}{4}\rfloor$ cliques, with tightness witnessed by the balanced complete bipartite graph. Erdős suggested the following strengthening: every $n$-vertex graph $G$ admits an edge decomposition into cliques with total cost at most $\lfloor \frac{n^2}{4}\rfloor$, where each $i$-clique has cost $i-1$.
